summary.text: Buffy Wicks represents the East Bay in the California State Assembly, in a district spanning Oakland to Richmond and including Berkeley and El Cerrito. She chairs the Assembly Appropriations Committee, after chairing the Assembly Housing Committee for two years.

paragraphs.text: According to her Assembly biography, she previously served for President Barack Obama for six years, and she lives in Oakland.
